title: shot_plan
description: The screenwriter's plan for one edit, written by scripts/llm_director.py before the editor picks exact timecodes: the story structure in beats and a slot plan naming which shot goes where, how long it should be and why. The editor turns this into edit.json; the reviewer checks the result against this plan and the brief.

shot_ref.description: shot key from shotlog.json: <clip counter>/<segment id>, e.g. 0081/s7

logline.description: one sentence: what this edit is about and how it feels

structure.description: the story beats in order; the sum of target_s should be the brief's target duration

intent.description: what this beat does for the story, e.g. 'open on the water, calm'

slot_plan.description: what each video slot should be, in timeline order; the editor picks the exact timecodes inside the shot's window

id.description: slot id, v1, v2, ... matching the edit it will become

target_s.description: how long the slot should be; the editor clamps it to the shot's window and the hero/semantic cap

why.description: why this shot serves the beat

keep_whole.description: true when the shot is a hero or a complete semantic move and must keep its whole window up to the cap

deliberate.description: true when the owner's feedback explicitly asked for both shots next to each other; the reviewer allows a same-segment-beat or similar neighbour pair only then

notes.description: anything the editor and reviewer should know
